The squirrel needs the tiger.

Predicates:
Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?
Nice($x, bool) ::: Is x nice?
Likes($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x like y?
Needs($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x need y?
Cold($x, bool) ::: Is x cold?
Chases($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x chase y?
Kind($x, bool) ::: Is x kind?
Young($x, bool) ::: Is x young?

Green(Cat, True) ::: The cat is green.
Nice(Cat, True) ::: The cat is nice.
Likes(Cat, Squirrel, True) ::: The cat likes the squirrel.
Likes(Rabbit, Tiger, True) ::: The rabbit likes the tiger.
Needs(Rabbit, Cat, False) ::: The rabbit does not need the cat.
Needs(Rabbit, Squirrel, True) ::: The rabbit needs the squirrel.
Cold(Squirrel, True) ::: The squirrel is cold.
Needs(Squirrel, Cat, True) ::: The squirrel needs the cat.
Needs(Squirrel, Rabbit, True) ::: The squirrel needs the rabbit.
Chases(Tiger, Cat, True) ::: The tiger chases the cat.
Chases(Tiger, Rabbit, True) ::: The tiger chases the rabbit.
Kind(Tiger, True) ::: The tiger is kind.
Nice(Tiger, True) ::: The tiger is nice.
Young(Tiger, True) ::: The tiger is young.
Likes(Tiger, Cat, True) ::: The tiger likes the cat.
Needs(Tiger, Cat, True) ::: The tiger needs the cat.

Rules:
Chases($x, Squirrel, True) >>> Needs(Squirrel, Tiger, True) ::: If something chases the squirrel then the squirrel needs the tiger.
Needs($x, Tiger, True) >>> Likes($x, Rabbit, True) ::: If something needs the tiger then it likes the rabbit.
Chases($x, Cat, True) && Likes($x, Rabbit, True) >>> Chases(Rabbit, Squirrel, True) ::: If something chases the cat and it likes the rabbit then the rabbit chases the squirrel.
Chases($x, Rabbit, True) >>> Needs(Rabbit, Tiger, False) ::: If something chases the rabbit then the rabbit does not need the tiger.
Kind($x, True) && Chases($x, Rabbit, True) >>> Needs($x, Tiger, True) ::: If something is kind and it chases the rabbit then it needs the tiger.
Kind($x, True) >>> Likes($x, Squirrel, False) ::: If something is kind then it does not like the squirrel.
Likes($x, Squirrel, True) && Needs($x, Tiger, False) >>> Likes(Squirrel, Tiger, True) ::: If something likes the squirrel and it does not need the tiger then the squirrel likes the tiger.

Query:
Needs(Squirrel, Tiger, True) ::: The squirrel needs the tiger.
